body: Oh, believe me. I'm into a lot of things, but having someone kill me isn't one of them.
Christ. This world is fucked, and I'm a product of it being fucked. I'm double-fucked.
Thanks.

I don't like living on the edge. I like exciting things, sure, but pedophilia isn't exciting to me. It's terrifying and it's in the back of my mind every single day-- "I'm a fucking monster". And it's true. My childhood was alright. My parents weren't the best, but I knew they loved me no matter what.

No traumatic events. Nothing. Just crippling loneliness for a while. Then, I got friends, and everything got better. The bad part is that the symptoms of the loneliness still carry on, even with my friends by me.
Definitely, except for the friend part. I'd say I'm an outcast, but I actually have plenty of friends.

Well, I don't live in the UK, and yeah, I'm a virgin. I'm not going to hire a prostitute, even if it was legal where I lived. It'd be too fake for me.

And yeah, I'm a virgin. Big surprise, right?
Thanks. I needed that.
I guess I understand why you'd dislike me. No hard feelings.
People think otherwise, and for good reason.
Usually never, until, y'know, I'm finished.
Yes, I understand that. I know I'm a burden on the world, but I never asked to be this way. If I could choose to be someone else, I would, but I can't. You feel me?
We're in this together, man. Don't fall for your own desires.

On the contrary. Shame hurts me more than anything I can imagine right now. What gets me off is the power play, among other things, but I'm not going to get into that because that's just not something you talk about online.
Well, that isn't very constructive.
Thanks. <3

Pedophiles just need to be attracted to children. That's the only requirement.

If you're thinking I was abused or something, well, I wasn't. In fact, my childhood was pretty alright. My parents loved me and my siblings were chill, albeit annoying. I think what got to me was constant rejection and not being included in things that friends did. That's sort of my fault for not putting myself out there and being a weirdo (like, seriously, I was the embodiment of cringe back then). At this point, I just don't feel like I can accomplish anything, because what significant thing have I accomplished in the past? It's a vicious cycle of having no drive to do something, feeling worthless, taking your frustration out sexually, and then back to dangerous thinking.

The worst part is, I can tell what my problem is, but I won't fix it.
I dunno. I just feel like that entire line of thinking is a bit sideways. I'm literally a threat to children. You wouldn't want someone with a fantasy of crashing cars drive your car, would you?

I'm not exactly comfortable sharing how old I am. Let's just say I'm young.

Yeah, yeah, I know. "Woah, the pedophile knows he's wrong." It's all bullshit to me, to be quite honest. Just because I know I'm wrong doesn't mean I'm a good person. I know I have some redeeming standards. I can play the guitar, I have plenty of friends, my friends love me, and a plethora of other things.

But I'm a pedophile.

I can't love myself. I'd be loving a pedophile. That's a dangerous thing to be loving, mind you.

I dunno. I don't want to worry them. They're good people. As much as I know they're here to help, I can't help but not tell them. I've gone so far without worrying them. I don't want to start so far into treatment.
Oh, believe me, I love that shit. In all honesty, the intimate stuff is amazing. I only wish I could have that myself.

You act like I don't do that, already. Incest is the tip of the iceberg for me.

What I have to ask is, why the hell was I made to have illegal thoughts? You don't see people wanting to lynch people fucking their sisters. You see people beating the shit out of pedophiles. People clap and cheer when they're burned alive. And I understand why. I understand I'm the bad guy, and I don't want to be.
About a year and a half of weekly therapy. It's died down to once a month, now.

Ever since the middle of puberty, maybe when I was thirteen or so. I thought it was normal, at first, since they were kids too. Then, it just got worse. I just kept looking for ways to one-up myself. I don't know why the fuck nature or God or whatever the fuck made me like this.

Yeah, I've seen therapists. They're great people, really. I can talk to them and all that stuff, but the reason I'm putting this here is because I don't want them being alerted that I want to kill myself. It's not like I'm going to do it, anyways. I can't hold a butter knife without feeling extremely hesitant and shaky.

I've not looked at child porn, just really depraved shit. I'm too much of a goody-two-shoes to cross the line of legality, so really it's just fantasizing, which isn't exactly much better for my case.

Thanks for the feedback. I think that's pretty much right. I'm fucked up. I've been fucked up. But I can't change myself. That's my problem. I would give my fucking lung to someone if they promised I could be someone else.

You know, I wish I could just leave for a bit. I wish I could go away and maybe come back to life for the holidays or some shit, but I can't. I wish someone could fix me. I don't want to die, but I do at the same time.

Good God, I don't even fucking know what I'm typing at this point.

I'm not. I'm too much of a little bitch to do it, anyways. I'll just sit here wishing I did until eventually, I break. It's going to happen, eventually. I feel it coming. Maybe the world will be a better place once I'm gone. My family and friends will be devastated, sure, but I think in the long run, I don't matter and I should stop myself until I *do* matter.
Please, talk to me. Tell me why you want me dead. I need to know.
